findings.title: Report-only (AI-output artifact, not feature misbehavior): re-score of an organic review reproduced a byte-identical headline
findings.expected: Assignment step 5 expected the headline to CHANGE from BEFORE as the visible proxy that a new review replaced the organic one
findings.actual: New summary 2540 (succeeded, stale false, score 29.41) replaced 2538 and IS a fresh generation — fit paragraph, all 5 criteria reasonings, Relevant experience, and Open questions all differ from BEFORE, one POST with rescore_requested true returned 200, and 1 credit was consumed (16 -> 15). But the AI produced the same headline string 'Software engineer specializing in backend development with Ruby and Go' from the unchanged resume + unchanged job criteria.
findings.evidence: GET .../ai_job_application_summaries/2538 (BEFORE) vs 2540 (AFTER) response bodies; screenshots 01 (before) and 04 (after) show identical headline over visibly different fit/experience text. Feature acceptance (non-stale current review regenerated again, replaced, charged) is met; headline sameness is provider determinism on identical inputs, not a gate failure. Reported so the orchestrator knows the literal 'headline CHANGED' expectation did not hold.
